reasoning_summary: Robert Florey, the director of 'Dangerously They Live', was born in 1900, making him 79 years old at the time of his death in 1979. Georges Lautner, the director of 'Salad By The Roots', was born in 1926 and was 87 years old at the time of his death in 2013. Since Robert Florey is younger than Georges Lautner, the film directed by him, 'Dangerously They Live', is the answer.
